parts.name: Base_Cup
parts.notes: AZ pedestal. Step at the puck underside (r 84-96) is the greased thrust face; 192 mm bore is the journal. Stingray-4 on four pillars, 4x M4x40 from under the floor. 6x M6 in the foot flange for a mount plate.

parts.name: Az_Retainer_Ring
parts.notes: Wide flange plate (12x M4x20 + nuts in the pedestal wall) trapping the puck lip: uplift + moment, and the visible AZ seam.

parts.name: Az_Stingray4
parts.notes: goBILDA Stingray-4 (4:1, 450 deg, 100 kg.cm), SKU 3215-0001-0004: direct AZ drive under the deck (block + servo + pinion).

parts.name: Az_Stingray4_Output
parts.notes: Stingray-4 output gear, hub and standoffs: turns with the head, bolted to the puck (4x M4x25 from the deck).

parts.name: Arm_R_1
parts.notes: Lower arm column (R), hollow, cables inside. Feet 4x M4x25 from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; socket for the upper spigot, 2x M4x50 across.

parts.name: Arm_R_2
parts.notes: Upper arm column + lower half of the shoulder drum (R): Stingray-9 pocket from the inner face, open cavity behind the translucent lens; block held by 8x M4 from the drum surface.

parts.name: Arm_L_1
parts.notes: Lower arm column (L), hollow, cables inside. Feet 4x M4x25 from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; socket for the upper spigot, 2x M4x50 across.

parts.name: Arm_L_2
parts.notes: Upper arm column + lower half of the shoulder drum (L): pillow block for the left stub bushing, on-axis encoder cap.

parts.name: El_Bearing_Cap_R
parts.notes: Upper half of the shoulder drum, 2x M4x25 into nuts trapped in the lower half; closes the top of the gearbox pocket.

parts.name: El_Bearing_Cap_L
parts.notes: Upper half of the shoulder drum, 2x M4x25 into nuts trapped in the lower half; holds the upper bushing half.

parts.name: El_Bushing_L_Lower
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Bushing_L_Upper
parts.notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

parts.name: El_Axis_Cap_L
parts.notes: Left axis cap: AS5600 column (2 mm off the stub magnet), translucent window; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

parts.name: Status_Window
parts.notes: Translucent disc in the left cap.

parts.name: El_Servo_Cover
parts.notes: Translucent lens on the right shoulder drum showing the Stingray-9; 4x M3x12 into cavity-loaded nuts.

parts.name: El_Stingray9
parts.notes: goBILDA Stingray-9 (9:1, 200 deg, 227 kg.cm), SKU 3215-0001-0009: direct EL drive in the right shoulder drum (block + servo + pinion).

parts.name: El_Stingray9_Output
parts.notes: Stingray-9 output gear, hub and standoffs: turns with the cradle, bolted to the hub's right wall (4x M4x12 from inside).

parts.name: Head_Puck
parts.notes: Rotating deck: 15 mm journal lip + thrust face (grease); bolted to the Stingray-4 standoffs (4x M4x25). Cable loop hole at the back.

parts.name: Az_Drum
parts.notes: Rotating azimuth housing (same diameter as the pedestal) = electronics bay. 4 pillars + ribs carry the yoke; M4x30 from below, M4x16 from above, nuts trapped in the pillars.

parts.name: Logo_Light_Pipe
parts.notes: Curved translucent plate behind the drum stencil (glue), LED behind.

parts.name: Yoke_Plate
parts.notes: Oval yoke plate / drum lid (244 x 220 mm): pillars 4x M4x16 from above (nuts in the pillars), arm feet 4x M4x25 each from below (nuts in the arm feet), translucent access cover 6x M3x25 (nuts under the plate).

parts.name: Yoke_Access_Cover
parts.notes: Translucent round access cover on the yoke plate (electronics visible); 6x M3x25 + nuts under the plate.

parts.name: Cradle_Hub
parts.notes: Hollow rounded hub, open top with a flush bolted lid: every flange bolt (left stub, boom, counterweight arm) ends in a nut inside the cavity; the right wall bolts straight onto the Stingray-9 standoffs.

parts.name: Cradle_Lid
parts.notes: Flush hub lid, 4x M3x12 into nuts trapped in the rim. Fit after all flange nuts and the standoff screws are in.

parts.name: El_Stub_L
parts.notes: Left EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings. Magnet in the end face.

parts.name: Dish_Boom
parts.notes: Round boom tube to the dish offset; round root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub; round end flange takes either adapter (4x M5 + nuts).

parts.name: Counterweight_Arm
parts.notes: Round tube with a row of M4 holes for the canister collar; round root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub.

parts.name: Dish_Adapter_Plate
parts.notes: Adapter A: slotted plate; 4x M5x12 into nuts pocketed in the boom flange.

parts.name: Dish_Adapter_PipeStub
parts.notes: Adapter B: 48.3 mm pipe stub.

parts.name: Counterweight_Canister
parts.notes: Opaque canister (~1.3 L); collar 2x M4x55 + nuts; cap 2x M3x10 with nuts inside the rim.

parts.name: Counterweight_Cap
parts.notes: Press cap, engraved PERIGEE; 2x M3x10 into nuts pocketed in the plug.

parts.name: Dish_Reference_1m
parts.notes: Reference paraboloid, not printed.

parts.name: Feed_Reference
parts.notes: LNB / feed placeholder.
